# Pre-built executable

`LaptopCheckPro.exe` in this folder is the **official release binary**, built
by GitHub Actions from the tagged source in this repository (see
`.github/workflows/build-exe.yml`) and committed here so the exe travels with
the code.

* Build provenance: Windows runner, Python 3.11, PyInstaller onefile.
* The CI job runs the headless self-test on the frozen exe before uploading.
* Prefer the copy attached to a [GitHub Release](https://github.com/cid0980/Laptop-check/releases) -
  it is the same file, named after its version.
* To rebuild it yourself on any Windows PC: `tools\build.bat`.

Do not edit this file by hand; it is replaced by the release pipeline.
